finding: Server activity feedback updates the confirmed weekly XP and then queues v085InstallWorld(false) while the Startseite is active.
V366's signature correctly detects the weekly value change, but that means the complete Startseite was rebuilt even though only the small Wochen-Truhe widget changed.
The activity feedback event is dispatched in the same task before the queued RAF reaches v085InstallWorld, allowing the beta helper to identify exactly that refresh.
changes: On growlegends:guild-xp-feedback, beta marks one short-lived weekly-feedback refresh window.
The next non-forced active-home v085InstallWorld call in that window is consumed and only .v6239-weekly-chest is replaced.
The new chest button is rebound to v6239OpenWeeklyChest.
V366's stored home signature weekly component is updated after the targeted paint, preventing a later catch-up full rebuild.
If the widget/API is unavailable or the timing does not match, the normal V366 full render still runs unchanged.
HOME-6 Frost checklist correction remains active after both full and targeted refreshes.
diagnostics: window.v8009HomeHeaderDiagnostics() reports weeklyWidgetPaints, weeklyFullRendersAvoided and weeklyFeedbackEvents.
